codeReview.summary: Reviewed the handoff commit 97bb99a4 (112 files, ~36.6k insertions) against architecture.md sections 2.1-2.2, 7.3-7.4, 9.1-9.6 and the feature's description/expectedBehavior, and judged the current combined code (later commits e5c6e296, 2c411941, 5e7c5b12, 661d65a5 included). All four expectedBehavior clauses are implemented and consistent with the authoritative architecture. (1) Generic alarm: apps/tenant-api/src/lib/org-alarm.ts registers modules and multiplexes them, staff-alarm.ts keeps its exports behind createStaffTickModule with the legacy staffTickOrgId storage key honored, reservations-alarm.ts registers the reservations module, and workers/tenant-org.ts registers both and routes alarm() to handleOrgAlarm with the [now+30s, now+60min] clamp; the pre-existing staff alarm tests are unchanged and green (the previously reported clock-flake needle '2222' in staff.adversarial.test.ts / staff.scope-limit.test.ts was replaced with '10000000000' by later commit 661d65a5, so it is no longer reproducible). (2) Tick: rsv-tick-service.ts runs expire_holds, expire_requests (via withReservationWrite's sweepExpiredInTx, which also queues request_declined), auto_no_show only where auto_no_show_after_min is set (no fees), waitlist_offers, notify_me_match, deliver_messages, deliver_outbox, reconcile_guest_counters and purge, returns counts plus nextDueAt/needsFollowUp, and skips with region_mismatch / no_reservations / flags_unknown / reservations_disabled (purge still runs with the module off). It is driven by POST /api/reservations/tick (INTERNAL_COMMAND_TOKEN only), the hourly 'Tenant reservations tick' fan-out in apps/jobs-cron/src/index.ts:155-161 (no new cron slot), the Node interval (RESERVATIONS_TICK_INTERVAL_SECONDS, default 120, min 60, 0 off) and the Durable Object alarm. (3) Messages: rsv-message-queue.ts enqueues inside the write transaction with dedupe keys <entity>:<id>:<kind>:<channel>:<schedule_version|milestone>, reconcileScheduledMessages is idempotent, and rsv-message-service.ts claims rows, re-checks eligibility (dead statuses suppressed, stale schedule cancelled, erased guest cancelled, waitlist status re-checked), applies the live kill switches as 'dropped' with last_error_code 'switch_off' (dropped, never held), retries after 1/5/30 minutes then 'failed' storing only a short error code, and raises one message_failed_bulk alert per location per 15-minute bucket. Quiet hours (21:00-08:00 local) are handled by @repo/reservations scheduleFor for scheduled kinds. lib/reservations-email.ts renders EN/AR escaped HTML with dir=rtl, hex theme colors, manage/status/book links, Google-calendar links and the per-kind/per-locale custom note; lib/reservations-sms.ts refuses anywhere but the US node as a second line of defense and channelsFor() never yields SMS on KSA. (4) Dev capture and manager alerts: tenant-api writes JSON to apps/tenant-api/.dev-mail/{us,ksa} (gitignored, production-guarded), the App viewer is MOCKS-gated and stripped by build:cf (STRIP_DEV_MOCKS=true); rsv-outbox.ts enqueues ids-and-counts-only events to POST /resources/reservations/notify, whose strict Zod schema rejects any extra/PII field, resolves recipients by permission and location scope, applies NotificationPreference, writes an in-app notification (kind, location id, count) plus an optional email honoring RESERVATIONS_EMAIL_ENABLED, and is idempotent per event id and member. (5) Waitlist/notify-me: rsv-waitlist-service.ts and rsv-notify-service.ts implement simulated quotes, response deadlines, on-my-way, seating (including the occupied-table swap/move/overbook path added by 2c411941), FIFO notify-me matching of 3 per opening with a 15-minute batch window and 120-minute repeat suppression; public waitlist/notify routes are gated on features.waitlist plus features.online and the location switches, and every waitlist/notify route is registered with and without a trailing slash. (6) Security: reservations-security.test.ts discovers operator routes dynamically and sweeps them (missing/forged/audience/typ/TTL/grant/scope/impersonation/cross-org/location-scope), covers the public waitlist and notify-me routes with forged/cross-org/rotated tokens and Turnstile, and asserts uniform 404 for hasProvisionedDb=false across every route. (7) Write path: every reservation write and setup mutation goes through withReservationWrite/withSetupWrite under the per-org lock; guest erasure sends cancellation_restaurant before clearing contact fields (rsv-guest-service.ts:941) and keeps append-only event history with redacted payloads. Carried-over gaps from online-booking-sites-and-app-ui are closed: availability slots carry areaId/areaLabel for guest-selectable areas, /reservations/config lists those areas, and the operator day feed and reservation detail return the recorded 'client' value. Acknowledged non-blocking behaviors from the handoff were re-checked and are either deliberate or fixed later: operator-created bookings are email-only (no smsOptIn field, by design), the availability ETag now folds the flag bits (later commit), and stale dev processes only affect local capture (services.yaml start commands set DEV_EMAIL_CAPTURE_DIR). No blocking issue found: every reviewed requirement has a concrete implementation and test or documented verification path.

issues.description: When the App context lookup fails (App unreachable), processRow holds every due message with HOLD_MS (10 minutes, line 50) instead of sending: `if (!context || !context.features.enabled) return hold()`. The kill-switch DROP semantics required by VAL-MSG-018/019 are honored (lines 492-499 set status 'dropped' when the env switch is off), so this is a conservative fail-safe rather than a spec violation, but a validator who runs the tick while the App is down sees delayed, not dropped, delivery and a 'flags_unknown' tick skip. The handoff already lists this; operational note is to start the App on 3001 before tick-based checks.

notify_available is a member of NON_URGENT_SCHEDULED_KINDS, so the shared scheduleFor() has a quiet-hours branch for it (shift to 08:00 local), but the only producer, enqueueNotifyMessage in apps/tenant-api/src/services/rsv-message-queue.ts:458-484, sets sendAt = ctx.now and never calls scheduleFor. A notify-me match inside 21:00-08:00 therefore sends immediately. This looks intentional (the guest is standing by for a same-day window, and a shift to the next 08:00 would point at a past business date), but it means the domain's quiet-hours behavior for notify_available is unreachable; if the deferred behavior is wanted, the enqueue path needs to use scheduleFor.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The feature description in features.json names `routes/resources+/jobs.reservations-tick.ts` as part of the deliverable, but no such App route exists and none is needed: architecture.md section 9.1 (lines 1582-1583) and section 2.2 (line 358) have jobs-cron POST the tenant nodes directly, like the staff tick, and VAL-MSG-027 asserts exactly that. The worker deliberately skipped it (handoff.whatWasLeftUndone) and the implementation follows the architecture. Future readers of the feature description may waste time looking for a route that was never intended.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: features.json description vs architecture.md:1582-1583 and :358; apps/jobs-cron/src/index.ts:155-161 invokes POST /api/reservations/tick on tenant nodes; handoff 2026-10-17T07-44-45-960Z__messages-and-waitlist-backend__9d16540b lists it under whatWasLeftUndone.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The root AGENTS.md gained only RESERVATIONS_EMAIL_ENABLED in this commit. RESERVATIONS_SMS_ENABLED, RESERVATIONS_TICK_INTERVAL_SECONDS and DEV_EMAIL_CAPTURE_DIR are documented in apps/tenant-api/.env.schema, apps/tenant-api/.env.example and docs/scheduled-jobs.md but not in AGENTS.md. VAL-DOCS-004 (payments-integrations-and-native) assigns the full AGENTS.md variable list to a later milestone, so this is expected, but a worker reading AGENTS.md today will not find the SMS kill switch or the tick interval.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Dev email capture only works when the tenant-api process was started with the current npm scripts, which set DEV_EMAIL_CAPTURE_DIR (.dev-mail/us, .dev-mail/ksa). Nodes left running from before this commit silently log instead of capturing, so validators must restart tenant-api-us/ksa (services.yaml start commands) before capture-based checks. The worker hit this with a stale duplicate KSA tsx watcher and restarted the nodes.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: apps/tenant-api/package.json:8-9 sets DEV_EMAIL_CAPTURE_DIR; handoff.discoveredIssues[4] 'Existing mission services were started by earlier sessions with the old npm scripts (no DEV_EMAIL_CAPTURE_DIR)'.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The manager-alert workflow names are the contract between planes and are duplicated in two places that must stay in sync: MANAGER_ALERT_KINDS in apps/tenant-api/src/services/rsv-outbox.ts:14-22 and RESERVATION_ALERT_KINDS in apps/app/app/utils/reservations/manager-alerts.ts:14-22. Adding a kind on one side without the other makes the App answer 400 to a valid outbox event (retried until OUTBOX_MAX_ATTEMPTS, then failed). Nothing in AGENTS.md or library/ records this pairing.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: rsv-outbox.ts:33-41 and manager-alerts.ts:31-39 are both strict schemas over the same kind list; the App receiver returns invalid_request for an unknown kind (apps/app/app/routes/resources+/reservations.notify.ts:75-84).

summary: Pass. Feature messages-and-waitlist-backend (handoff 97bb99a4) implements the guest messages, reservations tick, manager-alert outbox, dev email capture and waitlist/notify-me backend exactly as architecture.md sections 9.1-9.6 require: generic org alarm multiplexing with the staffing module and tests intact, a fully idempotent tick behind the internal-token route, the hourly jobs-cron fan-out, the Node interval and the DO alarm, transactional EN/AR escaped emails and US-only SMS with quiet hours and DROP-style kill switches, 1/5/30-minute retry backoff ending failed with code-only errors, ids-and-counts-only manager alerts into App notifications with preferences, and flag-gated waitlist/notify-me services with simulated quotes, FIFO 3-per-opening batching, 15-minute windows and 120-minute suppression. The security sweep covers every operator route plus the public waitlist/notify routes and the hasProvisionedDb 404, and all writes go through the serialized per-org write path. The earlier reported staff-test clock flake is fixed by later commit 661d65a5, and the handoff's ETag flag gap was closed by a later commit. Two non-blocking code notes (messages held 10 minutes when the App context is unavailable; notify_available bypassing the shared quiet-hours branch) and four shared-state observations are recorded; none blocks the feature.
